What if you grew one centimetre every second?
In under two minutes, you'd be taller than the tallest person ever.
In one hour, you'd match a twelve storey building.
In a day, you'd tower over the tallest skyscraper on Earth.
But your body wouldn't keep up.
Double your height and you'd be about eight times heavier, but your bones only about four times stronger.
So your legs would probably buckle long before the clouds.
Even if they held, space is a hundred kilometres up, and that's nearly four months of growing.
Growing is easy. Staying upright is the hard part.
